- README.md:206 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `LEDGER_EMIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` row says a timeout leaves the dedupe key unconsumed so a later substate can retry. The default-on job-scoped circuit breaker now skips later substates after a timeout, and the row does not mention `LEDGER_EMIT_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_ENABLED`.
  WHY: Operators who follow the documented retry behavior will not know that later ledger events are silently dropped, or that `LEDGER_EMIT_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_ENABLED=false` restores per-call retries. Reviewers rated this NIT, so low is the only severity reported.
- scripts/ledger_emit_substate.sh:630-653 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The circuit breaker treats every 403 as an authentication failure (reason=auth) and opens the circuit, even when the 403 is a transient secondary rate limit or abuse response.
  WHY: A transient 403 makes the job skip all later substate emissions, so the ledger state is incomplete for a job that might have recovered. The reviewer rated this MAJOR; MAJOR is mapped to high here.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/ledger_emit_substate.sh:630-653 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The circuit breaker treats 403 errors as authentication failures (reason=auth) and opens the circuit, even when the 403 is a transient secondary rate limit or abuse response.
  WHY: A rate-limited 403 from the memory store is transient. Opening the circuit skips later valid substate emissions for the rest of the job, leaving the ledger state incomplete.
- README.md:206 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The documentation still says a timeout leaves the dedupe key unconsumed so a later substate can retry. That is now incorrect, because the circuit breaker skips later emissions for the rest of the job.
  WHY: Operators will be misled about the durability of substate emissions when the memory store is unreachable or failing transiently.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  WHY: Under the default `LEDGER_EMIT_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_ENABLED=true`, the rest of the job's `run_substate` events are silently missing from the ledger. The row does not say that `LEDGER_EMIT_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_ENABLED=false` restores per-call retry.
